title: DIR-079: Align Top-Left Header Brand Block with Logo, GoSidebarCollapse Button & Vertical Divider
spec:

Header Left Brand Block in CubaAppShell.jsx: - Import GoSidebarCollapse and GoSidebarExpand from 'react-icons/go'. - In the sticky
, create a dedicated top-left brand zone that spans the width of the sidebar: * When expanded on desktop (md:flex): width is w-[var(--cuba-sidebar-w)] (260px) with border-r border-cuba-line (or border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-cuba-line) separating it from the rest of the header. * Inner layout: flex items-center justify-between h-full px-3.5 sm:px-4. * Left side: Authentic logo (). * Right side: Sidebar toggle button (data-testid='cuba-sidebar-toggle') styled as a rounded-xl bordered tile: className='cuba-focusable w-9 h-9 flex-none rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:border-cuba-line dark:bg-cuba-card text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-300 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors shadow-2xs' Rendering when expanded, and when collapsed. * When collapsed: width collapses cleanly to w-[var(--cuba-sidebar-w-collapsed)] (72px) with centered toggle button / brand mark. 2.
